body:
Welcome to the project page for the planned reconstruction of Shakespeare Drive (Browning Place to cul-de-sac on Shakespeare Place). The City intends to reconstruct this road to replace the aged watermain, sewers and road structure (i.e. sidewalk, curbs and asphalt). This will also include the replacement of water and sanitary services up to the common property line.
Follow this project for updates and information. Typically, major notices and updates will be posted here as well as delivered to nearby residents/owners. Minor updates may be posted on Engage Waterloo only.
Shakespeare Drive reconstruction location
